reason: Both plans hit every hard requirement, but Response B sequences the backup-before-modification requirement more carefully (calling out that the backup precedes actual replication slot/config changes) and its rehearsal step reuses that verified backup to restore into staging, which also validates the restore procedure itself rather than relying on a separate ad hoc snapshot as Response A does. B's post-cutover verification is also slightly more thorough, checking sequences, indexes, and constraints in addition to row counts and checksums.
